# Offering Discovery Protocol

> ODP lets agents discover a service's Offerings and find the Actions available for them.

For application integration, begin with the guided integration workflow below.
It includes an interview, repository assessment, an approved plan, and stepwise
implementation. Preserve existing authentication and payments; their integration
workflows are separate. Reassess the current repository when returning to improve
an existing ODP integration.

## Integration

- [Guided ODP integration](https://www.offeringprotocol.org/integration.md): Start here to integrate ODP or expand an existing integration.
- [Plan template](https://www.offeringprotocol.org/integration-queue-template.md): Maintain ODP-INTEGRATION-PLAN.md from repository confirmation onward.
- [Coding agents](https://www.offeringprotocol.org/documentation/quick-start/coding-agents/): Developer instructions and a copyable starting prompt.

## Reference

- [Documentation](https://www.offeringprotocol.org/documentation/): Concepts, implementation guides, and SDK guidance.
- [Specification](https://www.offeringprotocol.org/draft/): Protocol requirements.
- [Official SDK repositories](https://github.com/offering-protocol): Select the SDK matching the application.

## Separate integrations

- [AEP integration](https://www.aep.foundation/integration.md): Enrollment and authentication.
- [InFlow Payments integration](https://app.inflowpay.ai/integration.md): MPP and x402 payments.
